Pet of the Week: Ace

by admin July 31, 2026
written by admin July 31, 2026 0 comment
182
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Ace is a calm and incredibly lovable two-year-old husky with a heart as big as his fluffy hugs. He enjoys spending time outdoors, walks well on a leash, loves being brushed and is always happy to earn a tasty treat.

More than anything, Ace is looking for a family to call his own. Come meet Ace at the Devore Animal Shelter and see if he’s the loyal companion you have been waiting for!

Adoptions are free for qualifying pets and include complimentary spaying or neutering, a microchip and age‑appropriate vaccinations. To help ease your transition to pet parenthood, MetLife Pet Insurance offers 30 days of complimentary pet insurance.
